statement: Provenance is strictly separated. 'measured' entries point at committed artifacts on this branch with pinned SHA-256; the frontier builder refuses to run on drift. 'simulation' entries are placeholder-derived discrete-event outputs and are NEVER presented as measurement; only their capacity outputs are consumed and re-priced. 'assumptions' are explicitly not measurements and every dependent output names its assumption. Backends in 'unmeasured_backends' and cost classes in 'unmeasured_cost_classes' receive no latency, no per-request cost, and no empirical rank.

measured.environment: already provisioned t12 H100 (gpu-h100-sxm), storage attached, exact image residency proven before T0; see performance/COLD_START_METRICS.md
measured.notes: Fresh fail-closed cohort; conservative CLOCK_BOOTTIME upper bound; nearest-rank percentiles. semantic_request_2_seconds is the measured warm-hit (already-serving) latency of the same runs.

measured.environment: same t12 H100 cohort protocol as of2-n20-fresh
measured.notes: All 20 attempts measured and qualified; the cohort outcome is SLO_FAIL against the separate 20 s p95 target, which does not remove any sample from this cost model.

measured.environment: n20 cohort pre-T0 identity table; cache receipt SHA-256 e9c4a57dc2aed5795e9bef1b233154816862d84bb8f33c7dbd947629a9e46a25
measured.notes: LOWER BOUND for a request-triggered cold switch: the 13,341,111,872-byte attached cache was fully read pre-T0 (422.854590 s); the 16,241,056,616-byte M3 artifact was NOT read pre-T0 (O_DIRECT reads happen inside the T0 window and are already charged there); container image pull is excluded because image residency was proven before T0. A fully cold node would additionally pay image pull and any remote artifact localization.

measured.metric: warm-instance exact response-boundary n=3 totals (secondary reference)
measured.notes: n=3 lanes are reference-only in this model; only the n=20 cohorts drive per-request frontier rows because n=3 cannot support a p95 claim.

simulation.consumed_fields: reserved_gpu_hours, busy_gpu_hours, fetched_gib, latency p50/p95/p99, slo_goodput, hit rates, utilization
simulation.input_provenance: The simulator's MTBF, bandwidth, cache, conventional-init, drain, and reprovision inputs carry provenance:placeholder in reports.json; its low/base/high sensitivity levels move ALL placeholders together. Its placeholder cost_usd is ignored; this model re-prices capacity outputs with the sourced price snapshot.
simulation.notes: Commit 2d17c187 cherry-picked onto this branch. These rows must never be described as measured.

simulation.consumed_fields: per-point reserved_gpu_hours, fetched_gib, latency p50/p95/p99, slo_goodput, hit rates, utilization along the warm_top_k and l1_capacity_gib axes
simulation.input_provenance: Generated by costmodel/run_sweeps.py: each sweep isolates exactly one axis (warm-K grid 1/2/4/8/16; L1 cache 150/200/400/800/1600 GiB, floor set by the largest 143.19 GiB base-catalog artifact) with every other placeholder fixed at base and trace checksums asserted against catalog-sim/traces/CHECKSUMS.json. Placeholder-derived simulation, never measurement.

assumptions.name: snapshot_capture_seconds_of2
assumptions.basis: ARCHVTEAMS-2407 Phase 2 recorded measurement (agent checkpoint 272.426 s incl. CRIU 270.517 s) for OpenFold2 on H100
assumptions.why_assumption: The raw capture log lives on branch agent/archvteams-2407-p2, not on this branch, so it is consumed as a dated recorded value rather than a pinned artifact. It is OpenFold2-specific and MUST NOT be applied to any other model; no Boltz2 capture duration exists in this program, so Boltz2 capture cost is UNAVAILABLE and fails closed.

assumptions.name: preemption_loss_probability_grid
assumptions.unit: probability that a preemptible attempt is lost and retried
assumptions.basis: modeling grid; 0.44155844 is the computed break-even for H100 (1 - 2.15/3.85)
assumptions.why_assumption: No measured preemption-loss rate exists for the measured lanes; the 0/20 observed failure count bounds but does not estimate it.

assumptions.name: prep_reuse_grid
assumptions.unit: prepared-switch requests served per pre-T0 preparation
assumptions.basis: amortization grid for the cold-switch class; S=1 is the fully request-triggered worst case, larger S amortizes one preparation over subsequent switches on the same node
assumptions.why_assumption: Reuse depends on routing policy and demand mix, which are not measured; the frontier reports the full grid instead of assuming one point.

assumptions.name: restores_between_captures_grid
assumptions.unit: restores served by one snapshot capture
assumptions.basis: amortization grid for capture cost per model-version
assumptions.why_assumption: Recapture cadence is a policy choice tied to model-version churn, which is not measured.

assumptions.name: monthly_demand_grid_requests
assumptions.why_assumption: Catalog demand is not measured; the frontier reports break-even demand instead of assuming one point.

assumptions.name: hours_per_month
assumptions.basis: 365.25 * 24 / 12 rounded to the value the Nebius calculator itself uses (2810.5 / 3.85 = 730)
assumptions.why_assumption: Calendar convention; cross-checked against every captured monthly quote.

assumptions.name: failure_rate_upper_bound_rule_of_three
assumptions.basis: rule of three: 0 failures in 20 attempts gives a ~95% upper bound of 3/20
assumptions.why_assumption: Statistical bound derived from the measured 0/20 denominators, not an observed rate; used only for the pessimistic retry multiplier.

assumptions.name: on_demand_loss_negligible
assumptions.basis: on-demand instances are not preempted by policy; other failure modes are covered by the retry multiplier
assumptions.why_assumption: Used only inside the preemptible-then-on-demand fallback blend; not a measured availability claim.

assumptions.name: l2_fetch_billing_variants
assumptions.basis: Object Storage egress is $0.0150/GiB on the dated price page while VPC networking egress/ingress is listed free; which meter applies to remote artifact fetches depends on artifact placement
assumptions.why_assumption: Billing attribution of intra-cloud object reads was not verified against an invoice; both variants are computed and labeled.

assumptions.name: cross_region_relocalization
assumptions.basis: regional-loss fallback rows price the measured Boltz2 artifact+cache bytes (27.550541 GiB) under both egress variants
assumptions.why_assumption: Cross-region switch latency is unmeasured in this program; regional fallback rows therefore carry prices and capacity levels but no latency.

unmeasured_backends.reason: The sibling task catalog-switch-cerebrium-qwen3-glm52-benchmark is implemented but fail-closed at entitlement/capacity gates; no measured Cerebrium latency exists in this program as of 2026-08-19.
unmeasured_backends.what_exists: Dated public per-second prices in price_snapshot.json only, hash-bound to the archived payload.

unmeasured_backends.reason: The node-local runtime prototype (sibling task) has a planned-only lease and no live measured cohort on any reviewed branch as of 2026-08-19.
unmeasured_backends.what_exists: Same Nebius instance quotes apply; no measured latency.

unmeasured_backends.reason: Program scope correction of 2026-08-19: Modal is documentation-only; it must never receive a measured value or an empirical rank.
unmeasured_backends.what_exists: Dated public terms in MODAL_APPENDIX.md, hash-bound to an archived payload, outside every computation.

unmeasured_cost_classes.reason: OpenFold2's pre-T0 table records 'full read not applicable' (artifact identity-bound, payload not page-preloaded); no measured preparation duration exists, so no cold-switch cost is computed for it.
The legacy new-node lane is fail-closed on this branch (commit 730ca566) and no qualified fresh-node provisioning cohort exists here; the class is declared but receives no numbers.
